title: Thirteen Rīga councillors to move to parliament
summary_full: More than a quarter of the members elected to the Saeima are current members of district and local councils and leaders of their respective parliamentary groups. Among them are several controversial figures, whose presence used to cause Rīga City Council meetings to drag on considerably. A political scientist interviewed by Latvian Radio on October 5 suggested that the commotion from Rīga City Council will now shift to the Saeima.
